description: This file defines the DataBuffer interface with methods for managing a buffer of double values, including adding values, retrieving them, clearing the buffer, and static methods for calculating sum, average, and standard deviation.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: Interface for a buffer of double values with methods for adding values, retrieving the current values, clearing the buffer, and static statistical methods.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a double value to the buffer.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns an array of current double values in the buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer back to its initial empty state.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of an array of double values.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates the average of an array of double values.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of an array of double values.
